notes: Makes the folder's new files encrypted, or plain again (encrypted false; the encrypted ones stay readable). The first time, key is the first version of the folder's key, made on the admin's device: its private key sealed for the admin's person key and for the recovery key (share-e2ee-v1/folder, folder:<id>:1); everyone else who sees the folder gets it through the to-do list. Later, key is left out. Answers the folder as GET /api/folders does. Errors: 400 bad_request (the first time without key), 409 key_exists (key for a folder that has one), 409 no_key (no recovery key yet: PUT /api/recovery first), 404 not_found.
